title: Start Here: How Coaching Works
subtitle: Where your plan lives, when to speak up, and what I need from you.
description: Read this before your first full week. You will connect TrainingPeaks, learn how I write and change your plan, practice useful workout comments, and know what to do when life, fatigue, pain, or illness changes the week.

instructor.name: Matti Rowe
instructor.title: Head Coach
instructor.bio: I coach endurance athletes across gravel, road, mountain bike, and cross-country skiing. I made this because a welcome email is easy to lose and guessing wastes both of our time.

what_youll_learn: Connect TrainingPeaks correctly and understand the included Premium benefit
Read the whole training week before you worry about one workout
Handle missed, moved, shortened, or failed workouts without stacking them
Leave comments that tell me what the workout file cannot
Know when to comment, message, book a call, pause training, or seek medical care
Understand the Day 0, 2, 7, 14, and 28 onboarding checkpoints
